narrative.headline: Top 50 tilts decisively bullish (23 bullish/lean vs 23 bearish/lean) with defensives and semicap equipment names leading institutional accumulation while energy, healthcare giants, and AMZN/AMD face distribution.
bullish_setups: PG: max flow 10.0 + $250M dark pool — textbook defensive accumulation
UNH: flow 9.84 on $11M premium + $250M dark pool, healthcare bid despite JNJ/LLY weakness
KO/PM: both max flow 10.0 with $220M+ dark pool — consumer staples being loaded
CSCO: balanced 9.35 flow + $270M dark pool + blocks 9.82, quiet mega-cap tech accumulation
META: $30M call premium + $1.6B dark pool (largest in scan) + max blocks
KLAC/AMAT: semicap equipment pair both showing 8+ flow, max dark pool and blocks — capex theme
GOOGL: $37M flow premium + $900M dark pool, mega-cap tech leader
PLTR: $13.7M flow + $860M dark pool, still being accumulated aggressively
HD/WFC/MS: financials and housing bid with max flow 10.0
bearish_setups: LLY: flow 2.17 — healthcare divergence vs UNH strength
AMD: flow 2.73 with heavy dark pool/blocks suggesting distribution, diverges from semicap equipment bullishness
XOM/CVX: energy complex under pressure, both sub-3.2 flow with max conviction dark pool
AMZN: flow 3.48 — notable mega-cap tech outlier vs META/GOOGL strength
NFLX/AVGO: flow ~4 with max dark pool conviction on the bearish side
JNJ: flow 3.16, diverges sharply from UNH
narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation INTO defensives (PG, KO, PM, UNH), semicap equipment (KLAC, AMAT), and select mega-cap tech (META, GOOGL, PLTR, CSCO), and OUT OF energy (XOM, CVX), pharma (LLY, JNJ), and AMD/AMZN. Smart money is barbelling staples + AI infrastructure while distributing cyclical energy and lagging mega-caps.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: AMD bearish while KLAC/AMAT bullish — semis bifurcating between equipment (bid) and chip designers (offered). LLY/JNJ bearish while UNH bullish — healthcare splitting managed-care vs pharma. AMZN bearish while META/GOOGL bullish — mega-cap tech not monolithic.
